quests.name: War on the Woodpaw
quests.text: Bring 10 Woodpaw Gnoll Manes to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Lost for Words
quests.text: Bring proof of Namida Grimtotem's demise to Blaise Montgomery at Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Ogres of Feralas
quests.text: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.

quests.name: The Gordunni Scroll
quests.text: Bring the Gordunni Scroll to Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Gordunni Cobalt
quests.text: Orwin Gizzmick in Camp Mojache wants 12 samples of Gordunni Cobalt.

quests.name: Alpha Strike
quests.text: Kill 5 Woodpaw Alphas and return to Hadoken Swiftstrider within one hour.

quests.name: Woodpaw Investigation
quests.text: Find the gnoll battle plans somewhere in the gnoll camps to the south of Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Battle Plans
quests.text: Bring the Woodpaw Battle Plans to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: WANTED: Ohk'zi
quests.text: Bring the Staff of Ohk'zi to Latronicus Moonspear at Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Ruins of Solarsal
quests.text: Explore the Ruins of Solarsal and investigate the presence of the naga there.

quests.name: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold
quests.text: Return to Shandris Feathermoon in the Feathermoon Stronghold and report your findings.

quests.name: Against the Hatecrest
quests.text: Bring 10 Hatecrest Naga Scales to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Against the Hatecrest
quests.text: Report to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
quests.text: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Missing Courier
quests.text: Locate the courier's boat somewhere along the coast of Feralas.

quests.name: The Ogres of Feralas
quests.text: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Shaman, 10 Gordunni Warlocks, and 5 Gordunni Maulers.

quests.name: The High Wilderness
quests.text: Angelas Moonbreeze wants you to kill 8 Gordunni Warlocks, 8 Gordunni Shaman, and 8 Gordunni Brutes.

quests.name: Boat Wreckage
quests.text: Return to Feathermoon Stronghold and show Ginro Hearthkindle the Discarded Knife you have found.

quests.name: The Knife Revealed
quests.text: Take the Discarded Knife to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Psychometric Reading
quests.text: Speak with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
quests.text: Search the Woodpaw Gnoll camps of southern Feralas for evidence of the courier's belongings or the courier himself.

quests.name: Thalanaar Delivery
quests.text: Bring the Undelivered Parcel to Falfindel Waywarder in Thalanaar.

quests.name: Wild Leather Armor
quests.text: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Wild Leather Shoulders
quests.text: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Wild Leather Vest
quests.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Wild Leather Helmet
quests.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Wild Leather Boots
quests.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Wild Leather Leggings
quests.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Master of the Wild Leather
quests.text: Give Pratt's Letter to Telonis, the master leatherworker of Darnassus.

quests.name: Wild Leather Armor
quests.text: Bring 10 Thick Leather to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Wild Leather Shoulders
quests.text: Bring 6 Thick Armor Kits and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Wild Leather Vest
quests.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Breastplates, 2 Turtle Scale Gloves, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Wild Leather Helmet
quests.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Tunics, 2 Nightscape Headbands, and a Wildvine to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Wild Leather Leggings
quests.text: Bring 2 Turtle Scale Helms, 2 Turtle Scale Bracers, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Master of the Wild Leather
quests.text: Give Jangdor's Letter to Una, the master leatherworker of Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: A Grim Discovery
quests.text: Bring the Crate of Grimtotem Horns to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: A New Cloak's Sheen
quests.text: Bring 10 Iridescent Sprite Darter Wings to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: A Grim Discovery
quests.text: Bring 20 Grimtotem Horns to Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
quests.text: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Find OOX-22/FE!
quests.text: Take the distress beacon to Oglethorpe's homing robot in a cave near Feral Scar Vale.

quests.name: Rescue OOX-22/FE!
quests.text: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.

objectives.text: Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast

quests.name: Against Lord Shalzaru
quests.text: Eliminate Lord Shalzaru, and then bring the Mysterious Relic he uncovered to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Delivering the Relic
quests.text: Deliver the Mysterious Relic to Vestia Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: A Strange Request
quests.text: Take the Shrunken Head to Neeru Fireblade in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Return to Witch Doctor Uzer'i
quests.text: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Faerie Dragon Muisek
quests.text: Kill 8 Sprite Darters or Sprite Dragons. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Faerie Dragons.

quests.name: Dark Ceremony
quests.text: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to find a Gordunni Orb.

quests.name: The Mark of Quality
quests.text: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Mark of Quality
quests.text: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: The Writhing Deep
quests.text: Now that Raschal's last known whereabouts have been discovered, continue your search for him or his remains in the Writhing Deep. According to the note, it is located to the south of the Woodpaw gnoll camps.

quests.name: Freed from the Hive
quests.text: Free Raschal from the Zukk'ash hive.  Return to Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold and let him know that Raschal is alive and well.

quests.name: A Hero's Welcome
quests.text: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Rise of the Silithid
quests.text: Bring Raschal's Report to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus.

quests.name: Freedom for All Creatures
quests.text: Using the Bamboo Cage Key, free the Sprite Darters from the pen in the Grimtotem camp. At least 6 Sprite Darters and Kindal Moonweaver must survive.  You have 6 minutes before Kindal decides it is time to retreat and you fail the quest.

objectives.text: Save at least 6 Sprite Darters from capture

quests.name: Doling Justice
quests.text: Kill 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, and 6 Grimtotem Shamans before returning to Jer'kai Moonweaver in Feralas.

quests.name: Doling Justice
quests.text: Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

quests.name: The Gordunni Orb
quests.text: Bring the Gordunni Orb to Uthel'nay in the Darkbriar Lodge in Orgrimmar.

quests.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
quests.text: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: A Short Incubation
quests.text: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: The Newest Member of the Family
quests.text: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

quests.name: Food for Baby
quests.text: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

quests.name: Stinglasher
quests.text: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Testing the Vessel
quests.text: Travel to the Hinterlands, and locate the Wildkin. Kill 10, and use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Wildkin.  Bring 10 Wildkin Muiseks and the Muisek Vessel to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

quests.name: Hippogryph Muisek
quests.text: Kill 10 Frayfeather Hippogryphs of any type, then use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture them.

quests.name: In Search of Knowledge
quests.text: Talk to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Feralas: A History
quests.text: Ask Daryn Lightwind if you may borrow her book.

quests.name: Wild Leather Boots
quests.text: Bring 2 Nightscape Pants, 2 Nightscape Boots, and 2 Wildvines to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Becoming a Parent
quests.text: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.

quests.name: Zukk'ash Report
quests.text: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore. He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

quests.name: Improved Quality
quests.text: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

quests.name: Improved Quality
quests.text: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: Pristine Yeti Hide
quests.text: Bring the Pristine Yeti Hide to Pratt McGrubben at the Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

quests.name: Perfect Yeti Hide
quests.text: Bring the Perfect Yeti Hide to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

quests.name: The Borrower
quests.text: Take the letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris.

quests.name: Return to Troyas
quests.text: Deliver the book to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Super Snapper FX
quests.text: Use the Super Snapper FX to take a snapshot of Gammerita, then return to Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

quests.name: Zapped Giants
quests.text: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

quests.name: Fuel for the Zapping
quests.text: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

quests.name: The Giant Guardian
quests.text: Locate the lost night elf girl.

quests.name: Wandering Shay
quests.text: Pick up Shay's Bell from the chest.  Escort Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp.

objectives.text: Take Shay Leafrunner to Rockbiter's camp

quests.name: Treant Muisek
quests.text: Kill 3 Wandering Forest Walkers. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Treants.

quests.name: Mountain Giant Muisek
quests.text: Kill 7 Land Walkers or Cliff Giants. Use the Muisek Vessel to shrink and capture the fallen Mountain Giants.

quests.name: Natural Materials
quests.text: Bring 2 Splintered Logs, 6 Encrusted Minerals, 20 pieces of Resilient Sinew, and 40 Metallic Fragments to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Camp Mojache.

quests.name: Weapons of Spirit
quests.text: Witch Doctor Uzer'i wants you to wait for a moment while he prepares the weapons.

quests.name: Wisdom of the Guardians
quests.text: Prove yourself to the guardian spirits of Feralas, Azshara, and the Hinterlands, then return to Tyrisius in Feralas.

quests.name: The Stave of Equinex
quests.text: Energize Troyas' Stave and find the Equinex Monolith.

quests.name: The Morrow Stone
quests.text: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: Dark Heart
quests.text: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.

quests.name: Vengeance on the Northspring
quests.text: Talo Thornhoof wants you to kill 4 Northspring Harpies, 4 Northspring Roguefeathers, 4 Northspring Windcallers, and 4 Northspring Slayers.

quests.name: Jonespyre's Request
quests.text: Speak with Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Mystery of Morrowgrain
quests.text: Bring 10 Morrowgrain to Quintis Jonespyre in Feathermoon Stronghold.

quests.name: The Sunken Temple
quests.text: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Sunken Temple
quests.text: Find Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris.

quests.name: The Strength of Corruption
quests.text: Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas wants you to kill 12 Angerclaw Grizzlies and 12 Felpaw Ravagers in Felwood.

quests.name: Tribal Leatherworking
quests.text: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.  Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.  The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

quests.name: Again With the Zapped Giants
quests.text: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 10 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

quests.name: Refuel for the Zapping
quests.text: Collect 6 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.
